name: 80K Hours Upskilling Resources
current_details: A curated 67-resource guide to upskilling in technical AI safety, covering field overviews, courses (ARENA, BlueDot, Karpathy), project ideas, researcher advice, fellowships, and organisations. Free and self-paced, with free 1-on-1 career advising available.

name: 80K Hours AI Safety Career Review
current_details: Career review of technical AI safety research, covering empirical and theoretical paths. Empirical roles suit strong software engineers, even without ML backgrounds; theoretical roles suit strong maths or theoretical CS backgrounds.

name: AISafety.com Events & Training
current_details: Directory of 123 AI safety training programs, including fellowships, bootcamps, courses and workshops, online and in person. 58 are upcoming, filterable by stipend, length, entry bar and location.

name: AISafety.com Self-Study
current_details: A curated directory of 30 self-study curricula and reading lists for learning AI safety independently. Entries range from general introductions, such as DeepMind's 75-minute AGI Safety Short Course, to technical alignment, governance and strategy material.

name: Apart Research Hackathons
current_details: Weekend research hackathons open to anyone, online and at local in-person sites. The next Sprint covers Threat Intelligence & Threat Modelling. Standout participants are invited to Apart Studio, the route into the Apart Fellowship.

name: BlueDot Impact
current_details: Free online cohort courses in AGI Strategy, Technical AI Safety, Frontier AI Governance and Biosecurity, each 25–40 hours, plus in-person programs in San Francisco and $20k–$200k grants for moving into AI safety full-time.

name: Google DeepMind: AGI Safety Short Course
current_details: A free, self-paced introduction to AGI safety from Google DeepMind's safety research team: ~75 minutes of short recorded talks and exercises with a slide deck and workbook. Covers the path to superhuman capabilities, specification gaming vs. goal misgeneralization, DeepMind's technical alignment approach (amplified oversight, interpretability, control), and governance practices including dangerous capability evaluations.

name: MATS Slack #opportunities
current_details: Contract work, facilitation gigs, paper reviews, and collaboration opportunities from the MATS community.

name: NDIF — Looped Lens Challenge
current_details: Open interpretability competition: build a lens that reveals what Thinking Machines' looped open-weights model Inkling 2 Mini computes but doesn't write out. Run remotely on the National Deep Inference Fabric (NDIF) with a free API key; results go on a public leaderboard.

name: Outsider's Roadmap to AI Safety (LessWrong)
current_details: A comprehensive guide published in July 2025 for professionals transitioning into AI safety research from technical backgrounds such as software engineering, physics, or data science. Covers three critical domains: interpretability research (reverse-engineering AI systems to understand their inner workings), alignment research (ensuring AI systems remain beneficial and share human values), and AI control & governance (technical policy for advanced systems). Written by someone actively making the transition, synthesizing insights from Neel Nanda's mechanistic interpretability resources, 80,000 Hours career research, and the broader alignment community, with practical advice on evolving roles (the shift from separate research engineers/scientists toward 'full-stack researchers'), required skills, and pathways for newcomers to contribute meaningfully to the field.

name: Anthropic Fellows Program
current_details: Funded 4-month empirical AI safety research with an Anthropic mentor, covering scalable oversight, interpretability, model organisms, AI security and model welfare. Includes ~$15K/month compute funding plus a stipend. No PhD or prior ML experience required.

name: CBAI AI Safety Research Fellowship
current_details: Fully-funded ten-week in-person AI safety research fellowship in Cambridge, MA, with a $12.5K stipend, meals, housing for relocators and ~$1.5K/week compute. Applicants must be 18+ with US work eligibility; no visa sponsorship. An Expression of Interest form is open for the summer 2027 cohort.

name: ERA Fellowship (Cambridge)
current_deadline: Closed - Winter 2027 cycle runs Jan 18 – Mar 26, 2027
current_details: A 10-week full-time AI safety and governance research fellowship in Cambridge, UK, with three tracks: technical AI safety, AI governance, and technical AI governance. Fellows receive a competitive stipend, meals, transport, visa support, research management, a compute budget, and mentorship.

name: Iliad Intensive / Fellowship
current_details: The Iliad Fellowship helps technically strong scholars pivot into mathematical and theoretical AI alignment research in London or the Bay Area. Fellows must first complete the month-long Iliad Intensive, and about half receive a six-month research extension.

name: MATS (ML Alignment Theory Scholars)
current_details: MATS is an independent research fellowship pairing researchers with top mentors in alignment, transparency, and security. Fellows conduct 12 weeks of research in Berkeley, CA and London, UK, with an option for a 6–12 month funded extension.

name: AE Studio — AI Alignment Research Grants
current_details: Funds high-risk, high-reward alignment research beyond interpretability, evals and control, pairing researchers with dedicated engineering teams that need as little as one hour per week of their time. Open to alignment researchers and technical experts from other fields via an application form.

name: Pivotal Research Fellowship
current_deadline: Applications closed for the 18 Jan – 30 Apr 2027 cohort; expression of interest open
current_details: A 15-week full-time, in-person AI safety research fellowship at LISA in London, with weekly 1-on-1 mentorship and research management. Fellows receive a £15K–£18K stipend plus travel, compute, and £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows. Open to anyone 18+.

name: Second Look Research (UChicago XLab)
current_details: Paid-free research fellowship: a 10-week in-person program at the University of Chicago where fellows own replication projects from scoping through write-up. The page's banner says remote fellowship applications are open.

structured.location: University of Chicago (in-person); banner also mentions remote applications

name: SPAR
current_deadline: Mentor/org applications close November 30, 2026; fellow applications open December 16, 2026 and close January 13, 2027
current_details: SPAR is a 3-month remote fellowship pairing students and professionals with experienced mentors on AI safety, policy, and fieldbuilding projects. Fellows commit 5–40 hours/week and present at a virtual Demo Day with $7,000 in prizes. Open to all experience levels.

name: Foresight Institute AI Nodes
current_details: Foresight Institute's AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP funds AI projects across three calls: local compute, coordination and accountability, and AI-first science. Typical $30K–$100K grants include office space at San Francisco and Berlin hubs plus private compute, with in-person participation prioritized.

structured.location: San Francisco & Berlin (xNode in Cape Town)

name: Manifund Regranting
current_details: Manifund's AI Safety Regranting gives independent regrantors $100K–$350K budgets to fund AI safety projects from their networks or an open call. Grants can go to individuals, unregistered projects and, pending diligence, for-profits, often within days, not months. Example regrants range from $11K to $200K.

name: Meridian Cambridge — Research Accelerator Week
current_details: A 6-day in-person intensive in Cambridge, UK that helps technical AI safety researchers turn ideas into funded research proposals with Coefficient Giving. Participants meet 30+ researchers, form teams, and leave with a finished grant proposal. Travel, visas, accommodation and meals are covered.

name: Schmidt Sciences — Trustworthy AI RFP
current_details: Schmidt Sciences' funding page, which lists open calls across AI & Advanced Computing, Astrophysics, Biosciences and Climate Science. No open calls are listed right now, and the foundation does not accept unsolicited proposals. Subscribe to its updates to hear about new calls.

name: Schmidt Sciences — Scaling AI Safety for a Multi-Agent World
current_details: Joint funding call from Schmidt Sciences, Google DeepMind, ARIA and others for foundational research on safety in multi-agent AI ecosystems. Tier 1 up to $300K and Tier 2 $300K–$1M over 1–2 years. Decisions expected Autumn 2026.

name: Survival & Flourishing Fund (SFF)
current_details: SFF organizes grant evaluation for organizations working on the long-term survival and flourishing of sentient life, through its S-Process, Speculation Grants and Matching Pledges. The 2026 Main Round totals $63.64MM, and a $5–20MM ISPA Inspection Prize is offered for frontier AI lab inspections.

name: Catalyze Impact
current_details: Incubator that helps exceptional founders launch AI safety and resilience organizations, matching them with funders and domain experts. Its Funding Networks for investors and grantmakers require $50K+ a year and run 2–4 rounds annually, with 2–10 hours per round.

name: Halcyon Futures
current_details: Halcyon Futures is a grant-maker, incubator and investment firm backing founders in AI safety, cybersecurity and biosecurity. It combines grants, incubation support and venture funding. Prospective founders can contact the team directly at hello@halcyonfutures.org.

name: ImpactOps
current_details: ImpactOps is an operations consultancy giving hands-on support to high-impact organizations. It offers six services: finance, recruitment, entity setup, due diligence, ops audits and systems implementation.

name: Rethink Priorities Special Projects
current_details: Fiscal sponsorship and end-to-end operations for high-impact initiatives, including tax-exempt grant receipt, accounting, US/UK or Employer-of-Record hiring, visa support, recruitment, fundraising coordination and event planning. Fees are typically around 14% of project costs. Currently accepting expressions of interest for new projects.

name: Seldon Lab
current_details: Seldon Lab is an accelerator and venture studio backing founders building AI security and existential-safety technologies for world-scale AGI deployment. It offers capital, mentorship, and research collaboration. The most recent cohort's Demo Day was April 20, 2026.

name: WorkStream
current_details: WorkStream provides operations support for small and mid-sized nonprofits, including workflow optimization, fractional COO leadership, technology implementation, and fiscal sponsorship. Its six-month Operations Accelerator serves teams of 4-20 staff, alongside a 10-indicator GRIP growth-readiness assessment.

name: 80,000 Hours Job Board
current_details: A handpicked, continuously updated job board for high-impact careers, with a strong focus on AI safety, AI policy and global catastrophic risk. Filter by annualised USD salary, location and role type, and set up daily alerts for new roles.

name: AISafety.com Jobs
current_details: Continuously updated AI safety job board listing 584 open roles across research, policy, engineering, operations and communications. Salaries visible range from $80,000 to $450,000. Many roles are remote, and some internships are unpaid.

structured.location: Multiple (remote and on-site, Geneva, London, San Francisco, Berlin, Bengaluru, New Delhi, others)

name: Center for AI Safety (CAIS)
current_details: The Center for AI Safety is a non-profit reducing societal-scale risks from AI through research, field-building and advocacy. No specific roles are currently listed, but interested candidates can email hiring@safe.ai or submit a collaboration form. No technical background required, according to the page.

name: FAR AI Careers
current_details: FAR.AI's careers page invites applicants to help build trustworthy and secure AI across research, global AI events, and field-building programs. This page lists no specific roles, deadlines, salaries, or locations.

name: MATS Alumni Hiring Database
current_details: Account signup form for the MATS Alumni Hiring Database, which connects MATS alumni with organizations hiring in AI safety. Registration requires only a full name, email, and agreement to the MATS Privacy Policy. Exclusively for MATS program alumni.

name: MATS Careers (Staff Hiring)
current_details: MATS, an AI safety research mentorship program, is actively hiring across several roles tied to reducing risks from unaligned AI. No specific openings are currently listed; submit a general Expression of Interest form to be considered as positions arise.

name: Meridian Labs — Member of Technical Staff, Research
current_details: Meridian Labs builds open-source evaluation tools (Inspect AI, Inspect Scout, Petri) used by AI Security Institutes in five countries and by METR, Apollo and Redwood. Research role on automated alignment audits, agent monitoring and transcript analysis.

name: Mycelium — Research Scientist / Engineer
current_details: Full-time ML research on robust moral values in AI systems, with a focus on animal welfare and neglected moral patients: building benchmarks, evals and empirical research. Bay Area preferred, remote considered. $130K–$225K (senior $225K–$320K).

name: What AI Safety Orgs Want in a Hire
current_details: Survey of 38 AI safety organisation leaders on hiring needs, published by 80,000 Hours. Finds 1–3 years of relevant experience often suffices outside technical research, recommends BlueDot, Talos, MATS, GovAI, ERA:AI and Pivotal fellowships, and lists hard-to-fill profiles. Links to 300+ AI safety roles on the job board.

name: Apollo Research
current_details: Apollo Research hires across technical research, engineering, governance and operations on AI scheming, deception and loss-of-control risks, plus its Watcher AI security product. Most staff work in London or San Francisco with regular in-office days. Visa sponsorship offered; no internships.

name: Beneficial AI Foundation
current_details: The Beneficial AI Foundation is hiring remote researchers for two open roles: AI Safety Research Scientist at $35–$75/hour and Research Engineer at $30–$70/hour. Both roles are remote from anywhere.

name: Forethought
current_details: Research non-profit studying how to navigate rapid AI progress and the transition to superintelligent AI. Accepting expressions of interest and Founders Fellowship applications with no deadline. Based in Oxford or Berkeley (remote negotiable), with 33 days leave and a £5k/yr development budget.

name: Goodfire
current_details: Goodfire is an AI interpretability startup hiring agentic, mission-driven people across LLM and life sciences products. All roles are full-time and in person five days a week at its San Francisco (Telegraph Hill) office.

name: Gray Swan AI
current_details: Gray Swan AI is an AI security company hiring Software Engineers on a rolling basis. Benefits include 28 days off, a 401(k) with up to 4% matching, visa sponsorship, and 100% paid parental leave with up to 14 weeks of birthing leave.

name: LawZero
current_details: LawZero is a Montreal-based non-profit building safe-by-design AI for scientific discovery and oversight of agentic systems. The job board lists 13 roles across research, engineering, legal, partnerships and operations in Montreal and Berlin, plus a 2027 internship expression of interest.

name: METR (formerly ARC Evals)
current_details: METR is a nonprofit researching frontier AI agents and loss-of-control risk. Open roles include Government Affairs policy staff in Washington, D.C. ($306K–$471K), Head of Development ($206K–$306K), Head of People ($223K–$260K) and Recruiter ($153K–$246K) in Berkeley, plus a General Expression of Interest.

name: MIRI TGT Research Fellowship
current_details: Remote-first AI governance fellowship from MIRI's Technical Governance Team, pairing fellows with scoped projects on technical and political AI governance, such as chip monitoring and verification. Offers a $1,200/week stipend over 8 weeks at 40 hrs/week, with a Berkeley kickoff week. No visa sponsorship.

name: Redwood Research
current_details: Redwood Research, a nonprofit AI safety research organization, is hiring on-site in Berkeley. Technical roles pay $350K–$850K, and operations roles pay $200K–$300K.

name: SAIF (Safe AI Forum)
current_details: SAIF (Safe AI Forum) fosters international collaboration on AI safety, convening researchers and policymakers. There are no open roles currently, but the team invites expressions of interest via its contact form, including from candidates whose skills don't match a current opening.

name: Simplex
current_details: Simplex is an AI safety research organization using computational mechanics and interpretability to build a science of intelligence, studying belief state geometry, in-context learning, and factored world models in transformers. It is hiring Research Scientists in the Bay Area and London.

name: Transluce
current_details: Transluce is an independent nonprofit research lab focused on public understanding and oversight of AI, including the Docent agent-analysis platform, incident investigations, and independent evaluations. Open roles are listed on a separate Careers page, with no deadlines or pay shown on this site.

name: 80K Hours: Top US Policy Masters Programs
current_details: An Airtable directory of 12 US policy master's programs in national security, international affairs and public policy, mostly based in Washington, DC. name: Cooperative AI PhD Fellowship
current_details: Fellowship supporting PhD students and early-career researchers in cooperative AI and multi-agent coordination, with annual conference, compute, wellbeing and productivity budgets plus CAIF event travel. CAIF Scholars receive up to $40K/year for up to 3 years.

name: Cooperative AI Research Fellowship (Cape Town)
current_details: A full-time 3-month in-person research fellowship in Cape Town, South Africa, focused on cooperative AI safety, including multi-agent safety, AI for human cooperation, and gradual disempowerment. Fellows receive a $3,000/month stipend, flights, housing, and mentorship from Google DeepMind, Oxford, and MIT researchers.

name: FLI AI Safety PhD Advisor Directory
current_details: Directory of AI researchers committed to AI existential safety, including dozens of faculty and 125+ researchers open to advising students. Use it to find a mentor for FLI's Vitalik Buterin PhD and postdoctoral fellowships. Professors and researchers can apply for membership for funding and travel support.

name: Schmidt Sciences AI2050
current_details: AI2050 is a Schmidt Sciences philanthropic initiative supporting researchers worldwide on hard AI problems critical for society to benefit from AI by 2050. Early Career and Senior Fellows join an interdisciplinary community. No open application window is listed.

name: Americans for Responsible Innovation
current_details: Bipartisan AI policy nonprofit in Washington, DC advocating a proactive framework that protects Americans while preserving U.S. competitiveness. Roles are posted as they arise; non-employee referral bonuses are $3,000 (Director/VP) or $1,500 (other roles).

name: Career Accelerator (Horizon)
current_details: Horizon's part-time, remote 9-month program helps early-career and mid-career or senior professionals launch careers in AI policy through mentorship, application coaching, training modules, and a peer Slack community. Time commitment is up to 5 hours per week, and participants can request up to $100,000 in flexible funding.

name: CNAS Nye Internship
current_details: The Joseph S. Nye, Jr. National Security Internship places interns with CNAS research programs, communications, or Development, supporting policy research, publications, and events. Positions are full-time (40 hrs/week) for six months in Washington, DC, with a $1,900/month stipend plus $75/month transportation.

name: CSET Summer Internship (Georgetown)
current_details: CSET's 10-week summer internship at Georgetown in Washington, DC, offers research on AI, cybersecurity, the AI workforce, and biotechnology with senior analysts. Designed for students from HBCUs and other Minority-Serving Institutions, it is cost-free, with a competitive hourly wage, living stipends, and paid housing and travel.

name: GovAI Summer Fellowship
current_details: GovAI's three-month Summer Fellowship in London, on a Research or Applied track, lets fellows pursue an AI governance project with expert guidance, seminars and Q&As. The program runs 7 June – 27 August 2027. Applicants may apply from anywhere in the world, from early-career to experienced professionals.

name: Horizon Fellowship
current_details: Fully-funded policy fellowship placing fellows at Washington, DC host offices, including federal agencies, congressional offices, national labs, and think tanks, working on AI, biotech, and emerging tech policy. $78K-$190K+ salary plus $17K benefits stipend; 1-year renewable terms (6 months for junior think tank fellows). US work authorization required.

current_details: RAND's Center on AI, Security, and Technology offers full- and part-time staff roles in the U.S. and Europe, plus 18-month M.Phil. and 3–5 year Pardee Ph.D. programs with on-the-job training, and 9-month master's options. name: Tarbell AI Journalism Fellowship
current_details: A one-year fellowship for journalists and AI subject-matter experts, combining a three-month remote training course, a weeklong in-person summit, and a nine-month newsroom placement. name: ARC Visiting Researcher
current_details: The Alignment Research Center is hiring visiting researchers year-round, typically for 10 weeks (duration flexible). name: CHAI Internship (UC Berkeley)
current_details: Research internship at UC Berkeley's Center for Human-Compatible AI for people with ML, CS or maths backgrounds moving into human-compatible AI. Mentor-supervised projects typically yield first-author workshop papers. Runs 12–16 weeks paying $5,000/month in person or $3,500/month remote; international applicants accepted.

name: Center on Long-Term Risk (CLR) — Opportunities
current_details: CLR's hub for s-risk research. The Research Affiliates Program offers funding, affiliation and a research community for your own direction, alongside always-open CLR Fund grants and career coaching. The eight-week paid Summer Research Fellowship in London is currently closed.

name: Constellation Astra Fellowship
current_details: Constellation's flagship 5-month, fully funded, in-person fellowship in Berkeley, pairing emerging talent with senior mentors in Empirical Research and Strategy & Governance. Fellows receive an $8,400/month stipend. No prior AI safety experience required.

name: DeepMind Student Researcher
current_details: Paid, in-person internships for Bachelor's, Master's and PhD students working alongside researchers at Google DeepMind, Google Research and other Google AI teams. Placements run 12–24 weeks at five days per week in a Google office. Applicants must be enrolled in a degree program.

name: LASR Labs
current_details: LASR Labs is a technical AI safety research programme where teams work in person in London with an experienced supervisor to take a project to publication. Runs 13 weeks full-time at £5,000 a month.

name: OpenAI Emerging Talent
current_details: OpenAI's early-career hub offers internships, a research residency, and full-time roles in research, applied engineering, and product. Designed for 0–3 years of experience, including recent graduates and self-taught learners. An Emerging Talent Community offers networking and virtual Q&As.

name: Tilde Research
current_details: Tilde Research is a mechanistic interpretability lab hiring for 6 technical roles: ML Engineer, ML Researcher, and Hardware/Kernel Engineer, each as full-time or internship positions. Apply or inquire via join@tilderesearch.com.

name: Coefficient Giving — Project Tailwind
current_details: Project Tailwind is Coefficient Giving's call for founders to launch ambitious AI safety initiatives. It invites proposals that tackle critical, unsolved problems in AI safety, or founders' own ideas.

name: Thinking Machines Lab — Safety Research Grants
current_details: Thinking Machines Lab offers $50,000 in Tinker API/compute credits for safety research on open-weight models, launched alongside its Inkling and Inkling-Small releases. Suggested directions include defense-vs-offense uplift, hazardous-data classifiers, tamper-resistant safety training, emergent misalignment, reward hacking, and worst-case risk forecasting.

name: IFP — The Launch Sequence RFP
current_details: IFP's Launch Sequence RFP sought short (200–400 word) pitches for projects that accelerate science, strengthen security, or adapt institutions for advanced AI. Published authors received a $10,000 honorarium plus project-planning and funder support.

name: Paradigm 3 Research Fund
current_details: Paradigm 3's research fund supports external work measuring and forecasting AI capabilities and impacts, including AI externalities, benchmark gains, centaur evals, guardian-angel models, and recursive self-improvement. Pitch proposals to hi@paradigm3.org.

name: grantmaking.ai Launch Round

name: Falcon Fund (Manifund)

Focus areas include animal harm benchmarks, animal welfare AI constitutions, AI-in-factory-farming watchdog work, and animal welfare salience in AI labs. Grantmaking is mostly outbound, so donations and outreach go through the lead.

name: MARS — Cambridge AI Safety Hub

name: Collective Intelligence Project Research Fellowship

name: Frontier AI Security Residency
current_details: An 8-week, fully funded in-person research and engineering residency in Cambridge, UK. Residents tackle cybersecurity and hardware-enabled verification projects for frontier AI with expert mentors, alongside talks, poster sessions and a live-in cohort community.

name: Heron AI Security Research Fellowship

Runs the Singapore AI Safety Fellowship for researchers and Frontier AI Security Training (FAST) for policymakers and practitioners. Hiring globally.

name: Center for Technology & Statecraft
current_details: Non-partisan AI policy research initiative in Washington, DC, covering the AI transition, US-China competition, semiconductor supply chains, export controls and compute infrastructure. The page links to a Careers section but lists no specific internship, role, stipend, duration or application deadline.

name: Secure AI Project
current_details: Secure AI Project is a San Francisco nonprofit that develops and advocates pragmatic policies to reduce risks of severe harm from advanced AI, with a focus on California legislation. Its Careers page lists no specific openings.

name: SAIGE Incubator — Safe AI Germany
current_details: SAIGE Incubator is Safe AI Germany's part-time, remote research fellowship placing newcomers in small teams with expert mentors across four tracks. It runs 3 months plus an optional extension at 5–20 hours/week.

name: BlueDot Impact — Incubator Week
current_details: A 5-day, all-expenses-paid founder sprint in San Francisco where you and a potential co-founder test-drive building an AI safety organization. Pitches can win up to $200k in grant funding. Open to people in AI safety, biosecurity, cyber or other catastrophic-risk fields. No polished idea needed.

name: Neolithic
current_details: Neolithic is hiring a Member of Technical Staff to build open-source agentic tools for defensive AI safety research, one of its first hires. Full-time, in-person in San Francisco with $180K+ plus benefits and US visa sponsorship. Apply by emailing your CV and notable work.

name: d_model
current_details: Fundamental AI research lab building RL environments that train LLM agents to do open-ended interpretability and alignment research. Career interest is collected via a general Hiring Interest Form, and the team lists a Summer 2027 intern cohort.

name: Allelo
current_details: Allelo is a research initiative studying which traits make AI agents safe in multi-agent, adversarial settings, offered as a mentored project in the Pivotal AI Safety Fellowship. The fellowship runs 15 weeks full-time, in person in London.

name: RESI — Institute for Responsible Superintelligence
current_deadline: Interest form open for inaugural workshop, December 4, 2026
current_details: Independent nonprofit AI safety institute in Cambridge, MA building provable 'safe by design' foundations for superintelligence, modeled on modern cryptography. Runs an inaugural Safe-by-Design Superintelligence workshop (interest form open), plus a reading group and seminars.

name: Verified Mechanisms
current_details: Independent, grant-funded research project using frontier LLM agents to generate theorems about transformer internals, machine-checked in Lean 4. Outputs include an open-source multi-agent harness, the xorformer theorem ledger, and an oral paper at the NeurIPS 2026 AutoMLR Workshop. No formal application; contact via Discord or hello@verifiedmechanisms.ai.

name: PauseAI — Vacancies
current_details: PauseAI welcomes spontaneous applications from people who want to contribute to its mission to pause frontier AI development in a paid role. Send a CV and brief cover letter to vacancies@pauseai.info. Applications are kept on file for future openings, but a response isn't guaranteed.

name: ML4Good Technical Bootcamp
current_details: ML4Good's flagship free residential bootcamp for entering technical AI safety research. Food, accommodation and teaching are provided; travel may be reimbursed. Covers transformers, LLM agents, interpretability, RLHF, evaluations and governance, with a 2-day capstone. Requires a technical background and some coding experience. Regional cohorts run in English.

name: Successif
current_details: Free, personalized career advising for experienced professionals moving into AI risk reduction. Includes a dedicated advisor, resume and mock-interview support, expert workshops, self-paced courses, and direct introductions to AI risk organizations.

name: MIT AI Risk Initiative
current_details: Open CC BY 4.0 datasets and tools for identifying, prioritizing and managing AI risks, including a repository of 1,700+ risks from 65 frameworks and 2,206 mitigations from 47 frameworks. Also includes an AI Incident Tracker, company disclosures from the 200 largest companies, and the AI Risk Navigator. No applications; newsletter and partnership contact.

name: ALIGN — AI Alignment Network
current_details: ALIGN, a Japanese non-profit working on AI alignment research, community building and outreach, is recruiting volunteer staff for events, community management, PR, research, website and administration. Ideally 3–4+ hours/week with basic admin/IT skills; English welcomed. A paid 1–2 days/week role may be discussed. Apply via the Contact form.

name: Vegas AI Security Forum
current_deadline: TLV '26 on Nov 22, 2026 — applications open (DC Reading Group rolling)
current_details: Invite-based forum series convening AI, cybersecurity, and national security experts to secure powerful AI models, with editions in Las Vegas, DC, Tel Aviv, and Paris. Applications are open for TLV '26 in Israel and a rolling US-based DC Reading Group. Fiscally sponsored by Hack Club, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit.

structured.location: Tel Aviv, Washington DC, Las Vegas, Paris

name: ELLIS Institute Tübingen — AI Safety & Alignment Group
current_details: Research group at ELLIS Institute Tübingen building technical solutions to reduce risks from general-purpose AI. Focus areas include alignment of autonomous LLM agents, AI evaluations, public communication on frontier risks, and generalization. Team of four PhD students and one intern, based in Tübingen, Germany.

name: EA Funds — Transformative AI Fund
current_details: Early-stage, fast grants for individuals, new organizations, and existing organizations launching new transformative AI projects, focused on reducing catastrophic AI risks. Typical grants are $10k–$150k, rarely over $300k. Biosecurity and nuclear work are excluded unless they intersect with AI.

name: Anthropic — Careers
current_details: Anthropic's careers board lists 69 open AI Research & Engineering roles and 71 Applied AI roles across alignment, interpretability, safeguards, RL, pre-training and life sciences. It includes Anthropic Fellows tracks, with offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, London, Zürich and remote-friendly US postings.

structured.location: San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, London, Zürich, plus remote-friendly US

name: Google DeepMind — Careers
current_details: Careers page for Google DeepMind roles across research, engineering, product and operations, including Research Engineer, Software Engineer and Product Manager positions. Roles cover frontier models, Gemini, robotics and responsibility work, with a published interview process and locations listed on the page.

name: UK AI Security Institute — Careers
current_details: Careers at the UK government's AI Security Institute, the largest state-backed technical AI safety team, hiring across research, engineering, policy and operations. Hybrid London roles with 28.97% pension contribution, 25 days annual leave, and visa sponsorship for technical roles.

structured.location: London, UK (hybrid); also government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford, Bristol

name: US CAISSI (NIST) — Careers
current_details: NIST's CAISSI careers page for pre-deployment evaluation of frontier AI models. Roles are in-person in Washington, DC and San Francisco and require US citizenship. All teams currently state they are not hiring; Applied Systems participates in the NRC Research Associateship Program (February and August cycles).

name: Constellation Visiting Fellowship
current_details: A lightly-structured 3–6 month funded fellowship for full-time AI safety researchers, working from Constellation's Berkeley research center. No stipend, but housing, travel and meals are covered, with access to 100+ researchers. New cohort each quarter; visa support available.

name: Constellation Founders Residency
current_details: A six-month in-person residency in Berkeley for 3 to 6 founding teams building AI safety and security organizations. Free to join with no equity taken, including desks, a Residency Partner, hiring help, and funder introductions. Teams of up to four people may apply.

name: Resolution (formerly Timaeus)
current_details: Alignment research nonprofit hiring on a rolling basis for Research Scientist (Scalable Oversight), Research Engineer (Automation), Lean Engineer and Security Engineer roles. Several other rounds are paused but still accept applications. Successful referrals receive a $5k payment.

name: Epoch AI — Careers
current_details: Epoch AI, a research institute tracking compute, data, algorithms and AI capabilities, has open roles in Researcher/Senior Researcher, Software Engineer (Cybersecurity Benchmarks), Social Video Producer and Design Lead/Head of Design. It also accepts expressions of interest, including for Special Projects Associate roles.

name: Palisade Research
current_details: Palisade Research studies AI agent capabilities and motivations, including shutdown resistance and autonomous hacking, to understand loss-of-control risk. Its work spans technical research, policy engagement and institutional preparedness. The Careers page lists no specific roles, locations or deadlines.

name: SaferAI — Careers
current_details: SaferAI, a Paris-based nonprofit, is hiring a Founding Engineer (Infrastructure) and a Research Scientist/Engineer, both on its Evaluations team. The roles focus on helping leading AI companies manage risk. Listed openings include apply links; no closing date is shown.

name: Eleos AI Research
current_details: Nonprofit research organisation investigating AI sentience, wellbeing and moral patienthood, advising frontier AI companies and policymakers. The homepage lists no specific open roles, locations or deadlines; hiring appears occasional.

name: Talos Network
current_details: Talos Network trains and places people in European AI governance through three programmes. The 7-week Talos Fellowship suits early-career applicants and includes an optional 6-month stipended placement. The Policy Leaders Programme serves professionals with 8+ years experience, and Talos Incubator Europe backs founders with a monthly stipend.

name: Astera Residency
current_details: A fully funded 12–18 month residency in Emeryville, California for entrepreneurial innovators building public goods across AI research, neuroscience, life sciences, open science and deep tech. Residents receive a $125K–$250K salary plus a project budget of up to $2M, with compute and workspace provided.

name: ERA AIxBiosecurity Fellowship
current_deadline: Winter 2027 applications closed — join the mailing list for future rounds
current_details: ERA's fully funded AIxBio Research Fellowship brings researchers and entrepreneurs in AI, life sciences and policy to Cambridge, UK for 10 weeks in person to tackle open problems in AI-enabled biological risk. Fellows work on concrete projects with expert mentors and research managers, with 6mo+ Research Scholar positions for the most promising.

name: Pivotal — Frontier Biodefense Fellowship
current_details: A 15-week full-time biodefense fellowship at LISA in London, working on frontier threats such as PPE, biohardening and pathogen detection, with weekly 1:1 mentorship. Receives a £15K–£18K stipend plus travel and housing support; open to PhD students, early-career professionals and strong undergrads.

name: Council on Strategic Risks — Fellowship for Ending Bioweapons
current_details: Short-term fellowship for early- and mid-career practitioners to connect with mentors and build policy pathways on reducing deliberate biological-weapons risk. This listing shows no stipend, duration, location or eligibility details.

name: Johns Hopkins CHS — Emerging Leaders in Biosecurity
current_deadline: Closed — 2027 class selected; applications usually open in August
current_details: The field's flagship part-time fellowship, running since 2012 with 300+ alumni across government, science and policy. Over 10 months fellows attend two workshops and a symposium, with travel covered and no relocation. Needs a master's or doctorate, PhD enrolment, or 3+ years of relevant experience.

name: BlueDot — Biosecurity Course
current_details: Free, cohort-based online course on pandemic prevention as AI raises biological risk, for researchers, builders, scientists and policy people. No biology background needed. About 30 hours over an intensive 6 days or part-time 6 weeks. Graduates can access BlueDot grants.

name: BlueDot — Career Transition Grants
current_details: Funding of $20k–$200k for a defined period of full-time transition into AI safety or biosecurity work, with advising, targeted introductions and community. The application takes about 45 minutes, with decisions in roughly 2 weeks. Some countries are excluded.

name: Coefficient Giving — Biosecurity & Pandemic Preparedness
current_details: Funds work against catastrophic biological risks from advanced biotechnology and AI, including pandemic-proof PPE, metagenomic detection, Far-UVC and DNA synthesis screening. Has made 170+ grants totalling $360M+. Proposals can be emailed to the team, but the bar is high.

name: Fourth Eon Biosecurity Institute — Fellowships & RFPs
current_details: Fourth Eon funds people to scope new biosecurity programs, offering up to $75,000 over three months as a solo Program Architect or two-person team. Researchers already holding a fellowship are welcome. Email a short PDF proposal to programs@fourtheon.bio.

name: SecureBio
current_details: SecureBio hires for AI bio capabilities evaluations, metagenomic early-warning detection, and modeling, NGS, lab, field and talent roles. Most roles are in-person in Cambridge, MA; overseas applicants are welcome, visa sponsorship may be considered, and general applications are accepted.

name: Centre for Long-Term Resilience (CLTR)
current_details: London think tank advising the UK government on AI, biosecurity and risk management, with a dedicated Biosecurity Policy Unit. Lists live roles and runs a rolling open call for contractors on AI, biosecurity and AI–bio work.

name: Frontier Model Forum — Careers
current_details: The Frontier Model Forum is an industry body of frontier AI developers working on AI safety and security, spanning AI-Bio, AI-Cyber, AI-Nuclear, AI Security and frontier safety frameworks. No specific roles are posted; candidates can send a cover letter and resume to careers@frontiermodelforum.org at any time.

name: Valthos
current_details: Biodefense startup building systems that detect biological threats and design medical countermeasures in real time. Hiring 8 full-time on-site roles: 6 engineering and 2 operations, in New York and San Francisco.

name: Red Queen Bio
current_details: Red Queen Bio is an AI-powered biodefense startup building countermeasures against engineered biological threats as frontier AI advances. No roles are currently posted, but speculative applications are welcome by CV and note to jobs@redqueen.bio.

name: IBBIS
current_details: IBBIS is a Geneva-based Swiss non-profit safeguarding modern bioscience through the open-source Commec sequence screening tool, customer screening, and international biosecurity standards. The careers page lists no open roles; new positions are posted there and on LinkedIn.

name: Cambridge Biosecurity Hub
current_details: Cambridge, UK community growing biosecurity and pandemic preparedness through events, career resources and teaching. Its 7-week introductory Pandemic Prevention Fellowship runs once per term in Cambridge. The autumn cohort is currently in progress.

name: Oxford Biosecurity Group
current_details: Oxford Biosecurity Group runs part-time biosecurity research projects and an online Introduction to Biosecurity course. Apply to its talent database if you want to lead biosecurity projects; applications are reviewed in the next round. Sign up to the mailing list for other roles.

name: GCBR Organization Updates (newsletter)
current_details: Substack newsletter digesting updates from organisations working to reduce global catastrophic biological risks, covering biosecurity, pandemic preparedness, biosafety, dual-use, public health and AI-Bio. Written by Tessa Alexanian, with over 1,000 subscribers.

name: LawAI Summer Research Fellowships
current_details: Paid 10-week remote-first summer fellowship from the Institute for Law & AI for law students, lawyers and researchers working on AI law and governance, with optional in-person time in Cambridge (UK) or Washington, DC. Stipends are $1,800/week for US-based fellows or £1,000/week for EU/UK-based fellows.

structured.location: Remote-first; optional in-person in Cambridge (UK) or Washington, DC

name: ControlAI — Careers
current_details: ControlAI is hiring a (Senior) Policy Advisor in Washington D.C. and is open to Exceptional Talent applications for roles in the US and London. All positions are on-site and full-time.

name: Staffing the New Congress — Guide for AI Safety Applicants
current_details: Living guide for AI safety people applying to join the staffs of newly elected U.S. Congress members and governors, who are hiring over the next 2–3 months. Covers eligibility (most paid roles need U.S. citizenship), which jobs and offices to target, and where to send a resume.
